Delaroche shows Napoleon crossing the Alps on a mule, the realistic cousin of David's heroic version.

The people of Madrid rise up against French troops in the uprising that began the Peninsular War.

Van Gogh paints a train steaming across fields, the old and new worlds side by side.

Delacroix's painting of an Ottoman attack on the Greek island of Chios stirred sympathy for Greek independence across Europe.
